supersedes: Earlier optional7950 arena and single3s transformation are historical proposals, not this treatment.

sequence.direction: After checkpoint4650, about one screen onward, then about one empty screen without monsters/platforms. Enter a large pipe into fixed960x540 room.
Camera locks on both axes. Background pipe emits cockroaches; allow about2s skittering, then loud shriek/insects and2–3s rat assembly.
Telegraphed bite; pipe escape makes rat invulnerable in walls. A chosen wall/ceiling pipe shows roach warning about2s before launch and landing. Attack details belong to Mechanics/Engineering.
Defeated rat collapses and lies apparently dead for4–5s. Preserve this pause before renewed activity.
Roaches skitter again for4–5s, then assemble into larger alligator. Alligator assembly duration is unspecified; do not inherit obsolete3s transform.
Charged jaw/tail attacks, invulnerable water dive and vertical debris thrown by tail are commissioned attack directions; timing and fairness validation remain with Mechanics/Engineering.
Only final alligator defeat opens right pipe and releases camera for continuation. Exact release transition belongs to shared layout contract.

presentation: No mandatory dialogue. Let crawling, temporary stillness and renewed movement carry the reveal.
Do not announce victory, clear the encounter or open the exit during rat collapse. Preserve the apparent death without a false system-level completion reward.
Separate rat collapse audio from final death/exit confirmation. Renewed skittering must remain perceptible before reassembly.
Do not add a supernatural origin, allegiance or backstory; pending lore remains empty.
This miniboss does not replace the later Clogfather obligation.

capture_rules: Actual running-build screenshots require existing launch permission. Archive concept art separately; timestamp actual captures and record build. No game opened for this treatment.

timing_defaults.authority: Level Design integration defaults. Rat assembly implements user2–3s; false death and renewed skitter each implement user4–5s. Alligator2.5s is proposed, not an exact user number.

name_reconciliation: Canonical display name Skitterling; article in encounter prose was not a rename. Current naming status follows monster.json; earlier provisional discussions remain historical.
